1.0.0.title: Realm 1.0: one screen, straight to the realm
items: One screen: press Play and Steam opens your own Reign of Kings and joins the server.
Server status, players online and who holds the Old Throne, right under the Play button.
News from the realm: announcements, season news and Chronicle highlights, signed by the realm's owner.
What's new in the realm: new sculptures, sign art and events you will see when you join.
Realm keeps itself up to date. Every update is checked against the realm's signature before it runs.
